mapper.select: SELECT partner_idx, partner_nm, partner_status, partner_tel, partner_email, gender, CAST(create_dt AS TIMESTAMP) AS create_dt, CAST(update_dt AS TIMESTAMP) AS update_dt, partner_birth, p_zip_cd, p_address, p_address_detail, p_region FROM partner_mst ORDER BY partner_idx DESC

SELECT pm.zone_idx, sm.store_idx, TO_CHAR((COALESCE(szm.created_at, pm.create_dt) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS setting_date_ymd, AS store_nm, (SELECT cm.code_nm FROM code_mst cm WHERE cm.grp_cd = 30 AND CAST(cm.code_cd AS TEXT) = CAST(sm.store_type AS TEXT)) AS franchise_label, CAST(COALESCE(sm.brand_cd, szm.brand_cd) AS VARCHAR) AS brand_cd, (SELECT cm.code_nm FROM code_mst cm WHERE cm.grp_cd = 40 AND CAST(cm.code_cd AS TEXT) = CAST(COALESCE(sm.brand_cd, szm.brand_cd) AS VARCHAR)) AS brand_nm, sm.region_cd, (SELECT cm.code_nm FROM code_mst cm WHERE cm.grp_cd = 20 AND CAST(cm.code_cd AS TEXT) = CAST(sm.region_cd AS TEXT)) AS region_nm, pm.prop_nm, CASE WHEN pm.zone_idx IS NOT NULL AND szm.geometry_data IS NOT NULL THEN '설정' ELSE '미설정' END AS area_setting_label, COALESCE(szm.zone_nm, '') AS sales_area_nm, COALESCE(szm.zone_info, '') AS zone_info, (pm.zone_idx IS NOT NULL AND szm.geometry_data IS NOT NULL) AS is_area_configured, FALSE AS is_strategic_opening, (sm.store_idx IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(sm.store_type, '') = 'FR') AS is_franchise, NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(sm.address, pm.address, '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(pm.address_detail, '')), '') )), '') AS map_address, COALESCE( sm.latitude, pm.latitude, (szm.geometry_data #>> '{paths,0,lat}')::numeric, (szm.geometry_data #>> '{center,lat}')::numeric ) AS latitude, COALESCE( sm.longitude, pm.longitude, (szm.geometry_data #>> '{paths,0,lng}')::numeric, (szm.geometry_data #>> '{center,lng}')::numeric ) AS longitude, szm.geometry_type, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS geometry_data_json, pm.prop_idx FROM property_mst pm LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT sm2.store_idx, sm2.store_nm, sm2.closed_yn, sm2.store_type, sm2.brand_cd, sm2.region_cd, sm2.address, sm2.latitude, sm2.longitude FROM store_mst sm2 WHERE sm2.prop_idx = pm.prop_idx ORDER BY sm2.store_idx LIMIT 1 ) sm ON TRUE LEFT JOIN sale_zone_mst szm ON szm.zone_idx = pm.zone_idx
UNION ALL
SELECT szm.zone_idx, CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS store_idx, TO_CHAR((szm.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS setting_date_ymd, '' AS store_nm, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS franchise_label, CAST(szm.brand_cd AS VARCHAR) AS brand_cd, (SELECT cm.code_nm FROM code_mst cm WHERE cm.grp_cd = 40 AND CAST(cm.code_cd AS TEXT) = CAST(szm.brand_cd AS VARCHAR)) AS brand_nm, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS region_cd, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS region_nm, '' AS prop_nm, '전략출점' AS area_setting_label, COALESCE(szm.zone_nm, '') AS sales_area_nm, COALESCE(szm.zone_info, '') AS zone_info, FALSE AS is_area_configured, TRUE AS is_strategic_opening, FALSE AS is_franchise, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS map_address, COALESCE( (szm.geometry_data #>> '{paths,0,lat}')::numeric, (szm.geometry_data #>> '{center,lat}')::numeric ) AS latitude, COALESCE( (szm.geometry_data #>> '{paths,0,lng}')::numeric, (szm.geometry_data #>> '{center,lng}')::numeric ) AS longitude, szm.geometry_type, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS geometry_data_json, CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS prop_idx FROM sale_zone_mst szm WHERE COALESCE(szm.use_yn, false) = false AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM property_mst pm WHERE pm.zone_idx = szm.zone_idx ) ORDER BY zone_idx NULLS LAST, store_idx NULLS LAST, prop_idx NULLS LAST

SELECT CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS zone_idx, sm.store_idx, TO_CHAR( COALESCE(sm.cont_start_dt, (sm.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS setting_date_ymd, AS store_nm, (SELECT cm.code_nm FROM code_mst cm WHERE cm.grp_cd = 30 AND CAST(cm.code_cd AS TEXT) = CAST(sm.store_type AS TEXT)) AS franchise_label, CAST(sm.brand_cd AS VARCHAR) AS brand_cd, (SELECT cm.code_nm FROM code_mst cm WHERE cm.grp_cd = 40 AND CAST(cm.code_cd AS TEXT) = CAST(sm.brand_cd AS VARCHAR)) AS brand_nm, sm.region_cd, (SELECT cm.code_nm FROM code_mst cm WHERE cm.grp_cd = 20 AND CAST(cm.code_cd AS TEXT) = CAST(sm.region_cd AS TEXT)) AS region_nm, pm.prop_nm, CASE WHEN szm.geometry_data IS NOT NULL THEN '설정' ELSE '미설정' END AS area_setting_label, COALESCE(szm.zone_nm, '') AS sales_area_nm, COALESCE(szm.zone_info, '') AS zone_info, (szm.geometry_data IS NOT NULL) AS is_area_configured, FALSE AS is_strategic_opening, (COALESCE(sm.store_type, '') = 'FR') AS is_franchise, NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(sm.address, pm.address, '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(pm.address_detail, '')), '') )), '') AS map_address, sm.latitude AS latitude, sm.longitude AS longitude, szm.geometry_type, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS geometry_data_json, pm.prop_idx FROM store_mst sm LEFT OUTER JOIN property_mst pm ON sm.prop_idx = pm.prop_idx LEFT OUTER JOIN sale_zone_mst szm ON szm.zone_idx = pm.zone_idx WHERE sm.prop_idx IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sm.store_idx DESC

SELECT COALESCE(pm.zone_idx, szm.zone_idx) AS zone_idx, sm.store_idx, AS store_nm, COALESCE(szm.zone_nm, '') AS zone_nm, COALESCE( sm.latitude, pm.latitude, (szm.geometry_data #>> '{paths,0,lat}')::numeric, (szm.geometry_data #>> '{center,lat}')::numeric ) AS lat, COALESCE( sm.longitude, pm.longitude, (szm.geometry_data #>> '{paths,0,lng}')::numeric, (szm.geometry_data #>> '{center,lng}')::numeric ) AS lng, sm.region_cd, CAST(COALESCE(sm.brand_cd, szm.brand_cd) AS VARCHAR) AS brand_cd, szm.geometry_type, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS geometry_data_json FROM store_mst sm LEFT JOIN property_mst pm ON pm.prop_idx = sm.prop_idx LEFT JOIN sale_zone_mst szm ON szm.zone_idx = pm.zone_idx WHERE sm.store_idx IS NOT NULL AND (sm.latitude IS NOT NULL AND sm.longitude IS NOT NULL OR pm.latitude IS NOT NULL AND pm.longitude IS NOT NULL OR szm.geometry_data IS NOT NULL)
UNION ALL
SELECT szm.zone_idx, CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS store_idx, COALESCE(szm.zone_nm, '') AS store_nm, COALESCE(szm.zone_nm, '') AS zone_nm, COALESCE( (szm.geometry_data #>> '{paths,0,lat}')::numeric, (szm.geometry_data #>> '{center,lat}')::numeric ) AS lat, COALESCE( (szm.geometry_data #>> '{paths,0,lng}')::numeric, (szm.geometry_data #>> '{center,lng}')::numeric ) AS lng, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS region_cd, CAST(szm.brand_cd AS VARCHAR) AS brand_cd, szm.geometry_type, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS geometry_data_json FROM sale_zone_mst szm WHERE szm.geometry_data IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM property_mst pm WHERE pm.zone_idx = szm.zone_idx )
UNION ALL
/* 물건에 연결됐으나 가맹점(store)이 없는 영업지역 — 전략출점·신규 등록 */ SELECT szm.zone_idx, CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS store_idx, COALESCE(szm.zone_nm, '') AS store_nm, COALESCE(szm.zone_nm, '') AS zone_nm, COALESCE( (szm.geometry_data #>> '{paths,0,lat}')::numeric, (szm.geometry_data #>> '{center,lat}')::numeric ) AS lat, COALESCE( (szm.geometry_data #>> '{paths,0,lng}')::numeric, (szm.geometry_data #>> '{center,lng}')::numeric ) AS lng, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS region_cd, CAST(szm.brand_cd AS VARCHAR) AS brand_cd, szm.geometry_type, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS geometry_data_json FROM sale_zone_mst szm INNER JOIN property_mst pm ON pm.zone_idx = szm.zone_idx WHERE szm.geometry_data IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM store_mst sm WHERE sm.prop_idx = pm.prop_idx ) ORDER BY zone_idx, store_idx NULLS LAST

SELECT COALESCE(pm.zone_idx, szm.zone_idx) AS zone_idx, sm.store_idx, AS store_nm, COALESCE(szm.zone_nm, '') AS zone_nm, COALESCE( sm.latitude, pm.latitude, (szm.geometry_data #>> '{paths,0,lat}')::numeric, (szm.geometry_data #>> '{center,lat}')::numeric ) AS lat, COALESCE( sm.longitude, pm.longitude, (szm.geometry_data #>> '{paths,0,lng}')::numeric, (szm.geometry_data #>> '{center,lng}')::numeric ) AS lng, sm.region_cd, CAST(COALESCE(sm.brand_cd, szm.brand_cd) AS VARCHAR) AS brand_cd, szm.geometry_type, szm.geometry_data::text AS geometry_data_json FROM store_mst sm LEFT JOIN property_mst pm ON pm.prop_idx = sm.prop_idx LEFT JOIN sale_zone_mst szm ON szm.zone_idx = pm.zone_idx WHERE sm.store_idx IS NOT NULL AND (sm.latitude IS NOT NULL AND sm.longitude IS NOT NULL OR pm.latitude IS NOT NULL AND pm.longitude IS NOT NULL OR szm.geometry_data IS NOT NULL)

SELECT szm.zone_idx, CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS store_idx, COALESCE(szm.zone_nm, '') AS store_nm, COALESCE(szm.zone_nm, '') AS zone_nm, COALESCE( (szm.geometry_data #>> '{paths,0,lat}')::numeric, (szm.geometry_data #>> '{center,lat}')::numeric ) AS lat, COALESCE( (szm.geometry_data #>> '{paths,0,lng}')::numeric, (szm.geometry_data #>> '{center,lng}')::numeric ) AS lng, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS region_cd, CAST(szm.brand_cd AS VARCHAR) AS brand_cd, szm.geometry_type, szm.geometry_data::text AS geometry_data_json FROM sale_zone_mst szm WHERE szm.geometry_data IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM property_mst pm WHERE pm.zone_idx = szm.zone_idx )

SELECT szm.zone_idx, CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS store_idx, COALESCE(szm.zone_nm, '') AS store_nm, COALESCE(szm.zone_nm, '') AS zone_nm, COALESCE( (szm.geometry_data #>> '{paths,0,lat}')::numeric, (szm.geometry_data #>> '{center,lat}')::numeric ) AS lat, COALESCE( (szm.geometry_data #>> '{paths,0,lng}')::numeric, (szm.geometry_data #>> '{center,lng}')::numeric ) AS lng, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS region_cd, CAST(szm.brand_cd AS VARCHAR) AS brand_cd, szm.geometry_type, szm.geometry_data::text AS geometry_data_json FROM sale_zone_mst szm INNER JOIN property_mst pm ON pm.zone_idx = szm.zone_idx WHERE szm.geometry_data IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM store_mst sm WHERE sm.prop_idx = pm.prop_idx ) ORDER BY zone_idx, store_idx NULLS LAST

SELECT szm.zone_idx, sm.store_idx, TO_CHAR((szm.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS setting_date_ymd, AS store_nm, (SELECT cm.code_nm FROM code_mst cm WHERE cm.grp_cd = 30 AND CAST(cm.code_cd AS TEXT) = CAST(sm.store_type AS TEXT)) AS franchise_label, CAST(COALESCE(sm.brand_cd, szm.brand_cd) AS VARCHAR) AS brand_cd, (SELECT cm.code_nm FROM code_mst cm WHERE cm.grp_cd = 40 AND CAST(cm.code_cd AS TEXT) = CAST(COALESCE(sm.brand_cd, szm.brand_cd) AS VARCHAR)) AS brand_nm, CAST(COALESCE(pm.region, sm.region_cd) AS VARCHAR) AS region_cd, (SELECT cm.code_nm FROM code_mst cm WHERE cm.grp_cd = 20 AND CAST(cm.code_cd AS TEXT) = CAST(COALESCE(pm.region, sm.region_cd) AS TEXT)) AS region_nm, pm.prop_nm, CASE WHEN pm.zone_idx IS NOT NULL AND szm.geometry_data IS NOT NULL THEN '설정' ELSE '미설정' END AS area_setting_label, COALESCE(szm.zone_nm, '') AS sales_area_nm, COALESCE(szm.zone_info, '') AS zone_info, (pm.zone_idx IS NOT NULL AND szm.geometry_data IS NOT NULL) AS is_area_configured, FALSE AS is_strategic_opening, (COALESCE(sm.store_type, '') = 'FR') AS is_franchise, NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(sm.address, pm.address, '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(pm.address_detail, '')), '') )), '') AS map_address, COALESCE(sm.latitude, pm.latitude, (szm.geometry_data #>> '{paths,0,lat}')::numeric) AS latitude, COALESCE(sm.longitude, pm.longitude, (szm.geometry_data #>> '{paths,0,lng}')::numeric) AS longitude, szm.geometry_type, szm.geometry_data::text AS geometry_data_json, pm.prop_idx FROM store_mst sm INNER JOIN property_mst pm ON sm.prop_idx = pm.prop_idx LEFT JOIN sale_zone_mst szm ON szm.zone_idx = pm.zone_idx WHERE sm.store_idx = #{storeIdx}

mapper.select: SELECT szm.zone_idx, sm.store_idx, TO_CHAR((szm.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS setting_date_ymd, AS store_nm, (SELECT cm.code_nm FROM code_mst cm WHERE cm.grp_cd = 30 AND CAST(cm.code_cd AS TEXT) = CAST(sm.store_type AS TEXT)) AS franchise_label, CAST(szm.brand_cd AS VARCHAR) AS brand_cd, (SELECT cm.code_nm FROM code_mst cm WHERE cm.grp_cd = 40 AND CAST(cm.code_cd AS TEXT) = CAST(szm.brand_cd AS VARCHAR)) AS brand_nm, CAST(COALESCE(pm.region, sm.region_cd) AS VARCHAR) AS region_cd, (SELECT cm.code_nm FROM code_mst cm WHERE cm.grp_cd = 20 AND CAST(cm.code_cd AS TEXT) = CAST(COALESCE(pm.region, sm.region_cd) AS TEXT)) AS region_nm, pm.prop_nm, CASE WHEN pm.zone_idx IS NOT NULL AND szm.geometry_data IS NOT NULL THEN '설정' WHEN COALESCE(szm.use_yn, false) = false THEN '전략출점' ELSE '미설정' END AS area_setting_label, COALESCE(szm.zone_nm, '') AS sales_area_nm, COALESCE(szm.zone_info, '') AS zone_info, (pm.zone_idx IS NOT NULL AND szm.geometry_data IS NOT NULL) AS is_area_configured, (COALESCE(szm.use_yn, false) = false) AS is_strategic_opening, (COALESCE(sm.store_type, '') = 'FR') AS is_franchise, NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(sm.address, pm.address, '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(pm.address_detail, '')), '') )), '') AS map_address, COALESCE(pm.latitude, sm.latitude, (szm.geometry_data #>> '{paths,0,lat}')::numeric) AS latitude, COALESCE(pm.longitude, sm.longitude, (szm.geometry_data #>> '{paths,0,lng}')::numeric) AS longitude, szm.geometry_type, szm.geometry_data::text AS geometry_data_json, pm.prop_idx FROM sale_zone_mst szm LEFT JOIN property_mst pm ON pm.zone_idx = szm.zone_idx LEFT JOIN store_mst sm ON sm.prop_idx = pm.prop_idx WHERE szm.zone_idx = #{zoneIdx}

SELECT szm.zone_idx, sm.store_idx, TO_CHAR((COALESCE(szm.created_at, pm.create_dt) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS setting_date_ymd, AS store_nm, (SELECT cm.code_nm FROM code_mst cm WHERE cm.grp_cd = 30 AND CAST(cm.code_cd AS TEXT) = CAST(sm.store_type AS TEXT)) AS franchise_label, CAST(COALESCE(sm.brand_cd, szm.brand_cd) AS VARCHAR) AS brand_cd, (SELECT cm.code_nm FROM code_mst cm WHERE cm.grp_cd = 40 AND CAST(cm.code_cd AS TEXT) = CAST(COALESCE(sm.brand_cd, szm.brand_cd) AS VARCHAR)) AS brand_nm, CAST(COALESCE(pm.region, sm.region_cd) AS VARCHAR) AS region_cd, (SELECT cm.code_nm FROM code_mst cm WHERE cm.grp_cd = 20 AND CAST(cm.code_cd AS TEXT) = CAST(COALESCE(pm.region, sm.region_cd) AS TEXT)) AS region_nm, pm.prop_nm, CASE WHEN pm.zone_idx IS NOT NULL AND szm.geometry_data IS NOT NULL THEN '설정' ELSE '미설정' END AS area_setting_label, COALESCE(szm.zone_nm, '') AS sales_area_nm, COALESCE(szm.zone_info, '') AS zone_info, (pm.zone_idx IS NOT NULL AND szm.geometry_data IS NOT NULL) AS is_area_configured, FALSE AS is_strategic_opening, (COALESCE(sm.store_type, '') = 'FR') AS is_franchise, NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(pm.address, sm.address, '')), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(pm.address_detail, '')), '') )), '') AS map_address, COALESCE(pm.latitude, sm.latitude, (szm.geometry_data #>> '{paths,0,lat}')::numeric) AS latitude, COALESCE(pm.longitude, sm.longitude, (szm.geometry_data #>> '{paths,0,lng}')::numeric) AS longitude, szm.geometry_type, szm.geometry_data::text AS geometry_data_json, pm.prop_idx FROM property_mst pm LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT sm2.store_idx, sm2.store_nm, sm2.closed_yn, sm2.store_type, sm2.brand_cd, sm2.region_cd, sm2.address, sm2.latitude, sm2.longitude FROM store_mst sm2 WHERE sm2.prop_idx = pm.prop_idx ORDER BY sm2.store_idx LIMIT 1 ) sm ON TRUE LEFT JOIN sale_zone_mst szm ON szm.zone_idx = pm.zone_idx WHERE pm.prop_idx = #{propIdx}
